required_changes_injected: CRITERION 2 VIOLATION — Carry-forward Consistency: Champion component regressed from 4/10 (cumulative) to 4/10 (current) with new negative signals introduced (reduced meeting cadence, Clark Finley requesting cancellation, 'limited agenda items', 'only one feature flag in use') that paint a picture of DECREASED engagement and momentum loss. Should be: 'Ask Chris Sanders by [date]: Which specific person from mobile dev or C Squad is accountable for the June 30th migration timeline, and can you schedule a 30-minute call with them this week so we can identify technical blockers?'
